reply_text:
I've posted the Vantorre Group ticket list as a reply in the #strategic-pod thread. It's built from #strategic-pod, #inc-vtg-hartford and Moss's Strategic digests, with a source for each ticket.

- **#8841 (also written #PD-8841):** it shows up in four places, but they don't agree.
  - Gideon says in #strategic-pod on 7/1 that he closed it.
  - The 4/27 digest describes missed check-ins at Allentown, Gate 4.
  - The 5/4 digest says it was still open as a kiosk timeout at Allentown, Door 12.
  - The 9/30 digest has it submitted again for Newark, Door 14, which is after the 7/1 "closed". The digests also tie Newark to Mobility, so I told her to check this one against the support system before it goes to Mateo.
- **INC-4821:** #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 8/3, screenshot for the Hartford status-page access issue.
- **VT-55120:** #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 10/14, the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage.
- **#PD-4418:** from the 9/15/2025 digest, marked unconfirmed. It only says "the account Nadia runs", which isn't necessarily Vantorre Group.

I left out Vantorre Mobility's #4812, from the 3/10/2025 digest. The other digests mention Vantorre Group but give no ticket numbers. I told her this covers only those three sources, because I can't see the support system's own ticket records.
